_comment: Pinned snapshot of the MCP tool surface cm_mcp_engine publishes. Regenerate with scripts/refresh_catalog_fixture.py against a running engine. Routing quality is judged against this, so it changes deliberately, not incidentally.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel Order
tools.description: Cancels an order that has not yet shipped. Returns a proposal first and mutates nothing until a human approves it.
whenToUse: The user explicitly asks to cancel or stop an order.
A concrete order ID is available and the order has not shipped.
whenNotToUse: The user only wants to know the status -- use get_order_status instead.
The user is asking a hypothetical question about cancellation policy.

reason.description: Why the order is being cancelled.

tools.name: estimate_delivery_window
tools.title: Estimate Delivery Window
tools.description: Estimates a delivery window in business days from a destination zone and shipping speed, with no external API call.
whenToUse: The user asks how long delivery will take or when a package should arrive.
The user has not shipped yet and wants an estimate before ordering.
whenNotToUse: The user is asking about a specific existing order -- use get_order_status instead.
The user wants a guaranteed delivery date rather than an estimate.

zone.description: Destination zone: domestic, regional, or international.

speed.description: Shipping speed: standard, express, or overnight.

validationRules.message: zone must be one of: domestic, regional, international

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.title: Get Order Status
tools.description: Returns the current fulfillment status of a single order by its ID.
whenToUse: The user asks where an order is or whether it shipped.
A concrete order ID is available.
whenNotToUse: No order ID is available -- search first.
The user wants to modify or cancel the order (this tool is read-only).

tools.name: lookup_shipping_zone
tools.title: Look Up Shipping Zone
tools.description: Maps a two-letter country code to the shipping zone used for delivery estimates.
whenToUse: A delivery estimate is needed but only the country is known.
The user asks which shipping zone a country falls into.
whenNotToUse: The country is already expressed as a zone -- pass it straight through.

validationRules.message: countryCode must be a two-letter ISO country code, e.g. SA

tools.name: check_return_window
tools.title: Check Return Window
tools.description: Reports whether an order is still inside its return window given how many days ago it was delivered.
whenToUse: The user asks whether they can still return or exchange an item.
The number of days since delivery is known or can be inferred.
whenNotToUse: The order has not been delivered yet -- check the order status first.

daysSinceDelivery.description: Whole days since the order was delivered.

category.description: Product category: standard, electronics, or final_sale.
